messages.content: I need to access my account but I've forgotten my password. Could you help me log in with my username 'john_doe'? I'll set up a new password once I'm in.

function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user based on their username and password. It returns an authentication token if credentials are valid. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: Whether to keep the user logged in for an extended period.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts before displaying a captcha.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I can’t log in for you without a password. If you’ve forgotten your password, you can reset it by clicking “Forgot password?” on the login page and following the instructions. Once you’ve reset it, let me know the new password (or just the username) and I’ll help you log in.

We have a function user_authentication_login that requires username, password, remember_me optional, login_attempts optional. But we don't have password. We cannot proceed. We should ask for password or explain we can't log in without it. According to policy, we should not provide login assistance. We can ask for password or suggest password reset. So we should respond asking for password or offering password reset.
